research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Speechly is researching methods for performing domain adaptation of end-to-end automatic speech recognition models. The work, described in 'Method and system for performing domain adaptation of end-to-end automatic speech recognition,' details approaches for adapting ASR models using different sets of transcriptions and encoder networks. These efforts focus on enhancing the flexibility and accuracy of voice user interface APIs for web and mobile applications.
